provenance: All complete JSON OCPP frames from one retained charger LOG7628 export, in original member/frame order. Actual WS->/WS<- log records; sanitized and reserialized, NOT byte-for-byte wire capture. No parsed frames dropped or control-only selection. Raw archive and private identity map retained outside git.

transforms.transaction_ids: Stable integer aliases in standard and JSON-string fields.
transforms.plan_ids: Stable integer aliases in planId and clearPlans JSON-string arrays.
transforms.id_tags: Stable aliases preserving all observed idTag/parentIdTag lengths.
transforms.timestamps: One constant shift; earliest observed ISO instant becomes2030-01-01T00:00:00Z.
transforms.energy: One common whole-kWh register offset preserving Wh/kWh deltas and types.
transforms.private_fields: Credentials, configuration identities, URLs, filenames and status info replaced.
transforms.embedded_json: JSON-string fields remain strings; keys/arrays/types preserved.
